summary: Replaces the window by W9A2, a 13-term profile tuned for the nine-point certificate (cAMn and every window table, numeral and H literal regenerated and kernel-checked in-file), and regenerates the nine-point certificate on it: 11,794 checked leaves, weights refitted at 1e-14 resolution and the floor set to the largest value every guard allows. Keeps attempt-021/master-of-puppets5’s checker PC9QB6M and counting chain, and attempt-016’s window code. Walk literals are packed with the zfNat64 block from critical-strip-exclusion-attempt-1 (Zero Forge / @zkvoxels), reproduced unmodified with attribution. Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
method: Window W9A2 (tuned for n = 9) with a regenerated, exactly refitted nine-point Gram-defect certificate on master-of-puppets5’s file
